source.title: Clarify BanditRLlib's original aims and their alignment with Math 2.0
source.anchor: Math 2.0 slides pp. 22, 25–26; existing BanditRLlib public surfaces

target: Correct text-only chronological framing and invite collaborators; original project aims resonate with Tao's report. No theorem, evidence label, link destination or layout change.

reuse_plan.decision_reason: Reuse existing books, source/assumption atlas, Lean Graph, Functor Hypergraph, proof laboratory and contribution workflow as evidence. Add no theorem, adapter, graph edge or completion claim.

semantic_roundtrip.verdict: not-applicable: no new or changed mathematical statement
semantic_roundtrip.remaining_semantic_delta: No theorem/source formalization delta. Tao's examples are explicitly presented as examples, with no endorsement, white-box reasoning requirement or fixed nine-goal attribution.

graph_contribution.functor_reason: Only link to existing formal and conceptual views; do not add a conceptual bridge or alter mathematical graph semantics.
graph_contribution.visual_review: Text-only correction reviewed against the user's founding-goal clarification and existing public project history. The existing layout, nine direction IDs and evidence links are retained; this record does not reassert the earlier independent visual review for the new wording.

salvage.reason: The full gate stopped at mathlib cloning (git exit 128) before project Lean compilation; no proof work changed and no mathematical fragments were lost. Preserve all source and complete the standard-library site preview checks.

parallelism.expected_information_gain: One serial, bounded publicity correction; no parallel agents or mathematical proof routes.

reader_backpressure.exposition_evidence: New mission page distinguishes existing foundations from next contributions; no source theorem is newly labelled PURIFIED.

truth_boundary: Only the origin and alignment wording is corrected. New principles, proof ablations, generalized theorems and model development remain research aims needing evidence. README and positioning protocol accompany this change outside the protected-production file set.

focused_checks: Generator syntax and original-mission framing checks are required before push
